_comment: CNOSSOS-EU road emission coefficients for the vehicle categories buses fall in, per octave band 63 Hz to 8 kHz. Rolling noise L_WR = A_R + B_R lg(v/70), propulsion noise L_WP = A_P + B_P (v - 70)/70, v in km/h (20 to 130), reference road surface, dB re 1 pW per vehicle. Acceleration near a signalised junction (used for stops): + C_R and + C_P times max(1 - |x|/100, 0).
source: Commission Directive (EU) 2015/996, Annex II, Appendix F (road coefficients) and section 2.2 (acceleration correction), as amended by Delegated Directive (EU) 2021/1226.
check: unverified: values as published in the CNOSSOS-EU coefficient tables used by open implementations; read them against the consolidated Annex II before relying on them, then mark read.

rail_spectrum_shape_db._comment: A-weighted octave shape of rail rolling noise used to spread a pass-by level over the bands until the CNOSSOS-EU railway database is in the crate (relative levels, normalised to 0 dB total in code). Educated guess: rolling noise peaks at 500 Hz to 2 kHz.
